reports.title: arXiv 三维视觉与 Physical AI 日报 - 2026-07-01
reports.summary: 今日主体 34 篇、补充 0 篇；重点是 simulation-ready 4D scenes、任务条件化 3DGS 地图、Gaussian ray tracing/editing、长程 world model 评测、触觉/人形机器人操作和 occupancy-guided driving simulation。
trends: 今日 3DGS 主线明显从“可看”转向“可维护、可物理编辑、可进入机器人闭环”：GaussLite 把 Gaussian map 的容量分给任务相关区域，Streaming Gaussian Encoding 维护 4D occupancy 的时序一致性，GRay/Editable Reflections/Intrinsic GS 则把 ray tracing、反射和 intrinsic decomposition 带回物理一致渲染。
世界模型方向集中在“长程稳定”和“可用于规划”：PDR 用可微 3DGS 预测视频动态，MemLearner 学习上下文记忆查询，WorldRoamBench 把 interactive world model 的评测推到长时程稳定性和交互物理，DVG-WM 则为机器人操作解耦高层视觉生成与低层接触动态。

机器人操作与 Physical AI 的重点是把几何、接触和安全接口显式化：3D HAMSTER 把 2D VLA 轨迹落成 3D metric guidance，UniTacVLA/RoboTacDex 强化触觉模态，OopsieVerse 把 damage-aware simulation 加进 household manipulation，Human-as-Humanoid 则继续扩展从人类视频学习人形机器人动作的路线。
自动驾驶和仿真数据生成继续把 3D/occupancy 作为控制骨架：Horizon3D 做远距 radar-camera 3D 感知，InfiniVerse 用 occupancy guidance 生成无边界城市场景，DriveWeaver 和 ForgeDrive 分别处理可控车辆插入与 visual-action world model 的误差级联。

papers.title: One Video, One World: Turning Monocular Video into Physical 4D Scenes

category-aware 4D reconstruction into simulation-ready meshes
physical interface completion for embodied AI simulators

papers.title: GaussLite: Online Task-Conditioned 3D Gaussian Splatting for Real-Time Robotic Mapping
papers.authors: Annika Thomas , Mason Peterson , Jonathan P. How
papers.published: Published: Submitted on 29 Jun 2026; Batch: 2026-07-01 official arXiv new/cross listing; Listed: cs.CV/new; Categories: cs.CV, cs.RO
papers.summary: GaussLite 面向在线机器人地图，认为传统 3DGS 把容量均匀分配到整场景会浪费机载计算。它根据自然语言任务描述，把 Gaussian 密度集中到与任务相关的区域，同时保持可用于机器人规划的几何细节。对长期部署的移动机器人来说，这提供了一种“任务条件化地图预算”的思路。
methodHighlights: task-conditioned 3DGS density allocation
posed RGB-D online mapping with language task input
compute-aware geometry preservation for robotic downstream tasks

papers.title: Streaming Gaussian Encoding for 4D Panoptic Occupancy Tracking
papers.authors: Maximilian Luz , Thomas Nürnberg , Yakov Miron , Abhinav Valada
papers.published: Published: Submitted on 29 Jun 2026; Batch: 2026-07-01 official arXiv new/cross listing; Listed: cs.CV/new; Categories: cs.CV, cs.RO
papers.summary: 这篇论文提出 Streaming Gaussian Encoding，用可持续更新的 Gaussian state 表示 4D panoptic occupancy。相比每帧重算体素表示，它维护跨时间的几何、语义和实例一致性，尤其针对遮挡和静态背景稳定性。它适合自动驾驶与移动机器人中需要在线 4D scene understanding 的场景。
methodHighlights: streaming Gaussian state for 4D panoptic occupancy tracking
temporal consistency under occlusion
multi-view camera geometry plus semantic instance tracking

papers.title: GRay: Ray Tracing 3D Gaussians Near the Speed of Splats
papers.authors: Yohan Poirier-Ginter , Jean-François Lalonde , George Drettakis
papers.published: Published: Submitted on 29 Jun 2026; Batch: 2026-07-01 official arXiv new/cross listing; Listed: cs.GR/new; Categories: cs.GR
papers.summary: GRay 重新审视 3D Gaussian 的 ray tracing，目标是在接近 splatting 的速度下获得 ray tracing 的可编辑性和物理路径优势。关键观察是密集小 Gaussian 场景下，ray tracing 只评估被 ray 命中的 primitive，复杂度可能优于 rasterization。它对需要多反射、遮挡查询或物理一致渲染的 3DGS 系统很重要。
methodHighlights: fast ray tracer for dense 3D Gaussian scenes
logarithmic-style primitive culling along rays
optimization nearly 10x faster than prior 3DGRT in reported setting

papers.title: Editable Physically-based Reflections in Raytraced Gaussian Radiance Fields
papers.authors: Yohan Poirier-Ginter , Jeffrey Hu , Jean-François Lalonde , George Drettakis
papers.published: Published: Submitted on 29 Jun 2026; Batch: 2026-07-01 official arXiv new/cross listing; Listed: cs.GR/new; Categories: cs.GR
papers.summary: 该工作处理 3DGS 中镜面反射常被“假几何”吸收的问题，尝试恢复真实 reflector 与 reflected objects。方法利用 diffuse/specular buffers、BRDF/geometry buffers 和 Gaussian ray tracing，把反射生成放回物理路径中。它让 captured Gaussian scene 的 roughness、multi-bounce reflection 和反射内容编辑更可信。
methodHighlights: diffuse/specular buffer separation for Gaussian radiance fields
physically based specular path tracing over 3D Gaussians
editable reflectors and reflected objects including multi-bounce effects

papers.title: Intrinsic decomposition and editing of 3D Gaussian splats
papers.authors: Alexandre Lanvin , Jeffrey Hu , Simon Lucas , Adrien Bousseau , George Drettakis
papers.published: Published: Submitted on 30 Jun 2026; Batch: 2026-07-01 official arXiv new/cross listing; Listed: cs.GR/new; Categories: cs.GR, cs.AI
papers.summary: 这篇把 intrinsic decomposition 扩展到 Gaussian splatting 场景，把颜色拆成 diffuse albedo、shading 和 view-dependent residual 等层。每个 intrinsic layer 使用独立 Gaussian primitive 集合，以匹配不同成分的空间特性。它的直接价值是让 captured radiance field 支持单图编辑后从任意视角保持合理光照。
methodHighlights: independent Gaussian primitive sets for intrinsic layers
data-driven multi-view decomposition into albedo/shading/residuals
single-view edit propagation through intrinsic radiance field

methodHighlights: radiance-field-informed Gaussian optimization
sparse-view novel-view synthesis at real-time rendering target
geometry-sensitive augmentation for Gaussian initialization

methodHighlights: diffusion prior as material regularizer
joint recovery of geometry, material, and illumination
physics-based inverse rendering for relighting/editing

methodHighlights: dual SDF/UDF field representation for B-rep geometry and topology
shared latent flow matching for CAD generation
neural rebuilder extracts explicit editable B-rep models

mesh-oriented generative modeling for variable topology

methodHighlights: language-driven localization of geometric entities on meshes
multi-view reasoning for occluded or ambiguous target structures
mesh-level grounding for CAD, robotics, and simulation

methodHighlights: asynchronous online mapping plus background VLM semantic agents
incremental 3D scene graph with semantic loop closure
queryable scene representation during exploration

reduced capture burden compared with dense pinhole views

representation compression for immersive live streaming

papers.title: Learning Video Dynamics with Predictive Differentiable Rendering

papers.published: Published: Submitted on 30 Jun 2026; Batch: 2026-07-01 official arXiv new/cross listing; Listed: cs.CV/new; Categories: cs.CV, cs.AI

methodHighlights: predictive differentiable rendering for video dynamics

end-to-end future frame prediction with geometry-aware rendering

methodHighlights: learned context-memory querying for video world models
long-horizon consistency under occlusion and dynamics
interactive video generation with memory-aware retrieval

methodHighlights: open-world long-horizon benchmark for interactive world models

trajectory-level plus state-level evaluation

methodHighlights: disentangled video generation for embodied world modeling
separation of semantic visual synthesis and low-level dynamics
efficient planning loop for robotic manipulation

methodHighlights: 3D trajectory guidance for hierarchical VLA policies
bridges 2D VLM planning to point-cloud low-level control
reduces depth-induced waypoint distortion

safety benchmark beyond task success rate

reports.title: arXiv 三维视觉与 Physical AI 日报 - 2026-06-30
reports.summary: 最近一天命中 34 篇，补充 0 篇；3DGS 地图、具身世界模型和机器人几何接口最突出。
trends: 2026-06-30 官方公告批次里，3D Gaussian Splatting 从单纯 novel view synthesis 继续向可维护地图、语义可查询场景、动态 4D 表示和真实机器人闭环推进：L2D2-GS、KiloGS-SLAM、GaussDet、CubifyGS、MyGO-Splat、StereoGS、Graph-GSReg 和 VCS-SLAM 都在解决长期尺度、稀疏视图、语义一致和地图复用问题。
世界模型和仿真评测的主线更偏“可执行物理”：CrashTwin 用多智能体碰撞检验生成式世界模型是否遵守物理，ViPSim 把 visual space 与 parameter space 协同起来做长时程具身 rollout，OWMDrive 用 4D occupancy world model 为端到端驾驶规划提供未来先验。

机器人方向突出“几何接口进入策略”：VLK 用 3DGS 重建场景合成 humanoid loco-manipulation 监督，ZR-0 用 dense embodied chain-of-thought 对齐跨 embodiment VLA，OpenSPM、SPARK、Event-VLA、YOTO 和 DCGrasp 分别从空间记忆、锚点 keypoint、事件相机、触觉和距离场抓取补上低层几何约束。

HOI、手物交互和 articulated objects 也很密集：CoGS 与 IMU-HOI 强调人-物交互中的组件解耦和接触推理，EPIC-Contact/HOPformer 将 in-the-wild egocentric 手物接触标注推到 3D pose 层面，UnfoldArt 则把 text/image 到 articulated 3D object recovery 做成 agentic debate。
最值得优先深读的是 VLK、L2D2-GS、KiloGS-SLAM、ViPSim、GaussDet、CubifyGS、ZR-0、CoGS、CrashTwin、UnfoldArt 和 EPIC-Contact。它们的共同启发是：三维表示正在从“可看”走向“可问、可维护、可模拟、可规划、可接触”。

reports.title: arXiv 三维视觉与 Physical AI 日报 - 2026-06-29
reports.summary: 最近一天命中 26 篇，补充 0 篇；物理世界模型、结构化 3D 生成和机器人策略注入最突出。
trends: 2026-06-29 官方公告批次里，世界模型明显从“能生成视频”转向“能作为物理可用的模拟器”: PhysisForcing、P3Sim、DiM-WAM、CascadeOcc、Directing the World 和 MemoBench 都在处理动作条件、空间记忆、长期 rollout、物理一致性和诊断评测。

机器人方向的重点是显式结构注入策略: SimFoundry 用真实视频构建可编辑 digital twins，Direct Action-Head Injection 把 grounded 3D point 直接喂给动作头，SceneBot/CWI 用接触标签和组合模仿统一 humanoid loco-manipulation。
具身空间评测也在变细: AirGroundBench 评估 UAV-UGV 多视角协作，LocalNav 关注端侧 VLM 物体导航，LXD-SLAM 把多传感器 dense mapping 做成可插拔组合。
最值得优先深读的是 PhysisForcing、P3Sim、HAT-4D、SimFoundry、ReScene、StructSplat、DiM-WAM、DexCompose、CascadeOcc 和 Direct Action-Head Injection。

reports.title: arXiv 三维视觉与 Physical AI 日报 - 2026-06-26
reports.summary: 最近一天命中 25 篇，补充 0 篇；物理世界模型、3DGS 几何保护和接触式机器人操作最突出。
trends: 2026-06-26 官方新公告批次里，3D/4D 表示和世界模型明显向物理可控性靠拢: PhysiFormer、Neural Voxel Dynamics、PhysEditWorld、Fast LeWorldModel、DexAC-WM 和 Hallucination in World Models 都在处理动作、几何、物理状态与长期 rollout 的一致性问题。
3DGS/NeRF 方向的关键词是几何保护和可诊断: SatSplatDiff、PanoImager、SceneStyler、Vis4GS、RayPE 和 Sculpting NeRF Geometry 分别从卫星重建、稀疏全景、风格一致性、训练可解释、射线编码和偏好优化切入。
机器人操作的热点集中在接触和物理反馈: Play2Perfect、VibeAct、Tactile-WAM、PressMimic、RelAfford6D、SSI-Policy 和 Motion Feasibility from Point Clouds 都在把触觉、压力、点云、6D affordance 或阶段结构显式注入策略。
具身数据和评测继续向真实长时程移动: OctoSense、WatchAct、RobOralScan、OmniContact 和 E-TTS 分别补多模态传感、行为 grounding、主动三维扫描、HOI 式 humanoid loco-manipulation 与测试时扩展。

最值得优先深读的是 PhysiFormer、Neural Voxel Dynamics、PhysEditWorld、KRVF、RelAfford6D、VibeAct、Tactile-WAM、RayPE、PanoImager 和 Hallucination in World Models；它们对三维重建、世界模型和 Physical AI 的共同启发是: 仅有视觉逼真不够，模型必须把几何坐标、接触、物理参数、传感来源和数据覆盖显式纳入闭环。

papers.published: arXiv API published 2026-06-24T22:06:35Z; official announcement batch: 2026-06-26 (/list cs.CV/new); categories: cs.CV
papers.summary: 这篇论文同样针对视频世界模型缺少 3D 几何基础的问题，但选择从单目视频监督中自监督学习 3D 体素动力学。方法先用 monocular depth prior 将 V-JEPA 语义特征抬升到 voxel latent space，再用 Volumetric Feature Advection 学习 action-conditioned transition operator。物理状态不再是 2D 图像 token 的隐式漂移，而是在体素特征中被平流和演化。它对动态世界模型的价值在于，用被动视频也能学习保持对象永久性和长期结构稳定的隐式 3D 物理。
methodHighlights: lifts video features into depth-grounded 3D voxel latent space
volumetric feature advection models action-conditioned physical transitions
self-supervised from video-derived signals without simulator internals

papers.title: PhysEditWorld: A Large-Scale Dataset Toward Physics-Editable World Models
papers.authors: Bin Hu, Yanwen Ma, Jiehui Huang, Ziliang Zhang, Haoning Wu, Ruicheng Zhang, Yaokun Li, Zijun Wang, Yuechen Zhang, Chun-Mei Tseng, Hanhui Li, Shengju Qian, Jun Zhou, Kaipeng Zhang, Xiaodan Liang, Jiaya Jia, Xiu Li
papers.published: arXiv API published 2026-06-25T07:27:09Z; official announcement batch: 2026-06-26 (/list cs.CV/new); categories: cs.CV
papers.summary: PhysEditWorld 是面向 physics-editable world models 的 UE5 数据集，重点把物理参数从隐式相关性变成显式可控变量。数据通过 replay-and-rendering pipeline 固定初始状态、动作序列和相机策略，只改变重力等物理配置，从而得到可归因的物理变化。它包含 12 个 cinematic 场景、100 多小时交互和 6000 万以上 rollout frames，并同步 RGB、depth、normal、audio、action traces、camera trajectory、engine states、semantic annotations 和 gravity labels。对世界模型研究而言，这是把“能生成”推进到“能物理编辑并保持一致”的基础设施。
methodHighlights: UE5 replay paradigm isolates controllable physical parameters
multimodal rollout data with depth, normals, action traces, camera trajectories, and engine states
utility studies for gravity-faithful video generation and world understanding

papers.title: Fast LeWorldModel
papers.authors: Yuntian Gao, Xiangyu Xu
papers.published: arXiv API published 2026-06-24T17:59:59Z; official announcement batch: 2026-06-26 (/list cs.LG/new); categories: cs.LG, cs.CV, cs.RO
papers.summary: Fast LeWorldModel 关注 reconstruction-free visual world model 在规划阶段的计算瓶颈。原 LeWorldModel 需要自回归地一步步 rollout 候选动作序列，规划慢且误差会随 horizon 累积。Fast-LeWM 改为 action-prefix prediction: 对动作序列前缀并行编码，直接预测不同前缀执行后的未来 latent。这样既减少规划时间，也让模型学习多步动作效果如何逐渐累积，对机器人视觉规划中的 latent world model 很实用。
methodHighlights: action-prefix prediction replaces autoregressive latent rollout
parallel evaluation of candidate action sequences
reduces planning time and slows latent error growth over horizon

papers.title: Hallucination in World Models is Predictable and Preventable
papers.authors: Nicklas Hansen, Xiaolong Wang
papers.published: arXiv API published 2026-06-25T17:38:45Z; official announcement batch: 2026-06-26 (/list cs.LG/new); categories: cs.LG, cs.CV, cs.RO
papers.summary: 这篇论文把生成式世界模型的 hallucination 归因到 state-action coverage 的低覆盖区域，而不是简单归咎于模型容量。作者构建 MMBench2，包含 427 小时、210 个任务、真实动作、奖励和 live simulators，并训练 350M 参数世界模型分析错误。论文区分 perceptual、action-marginalized 和 scene-diverging 三类 hallucination，并提出能提前预测失败的轻量信号。更重要的是，这些信号还能作为采样和在线数据收集策略，帮助模型用少量新轨迹适配未见环境。
methodHighlights: MMBench2 with actions, rewards, and live simulators
predictors for three hallucination modes
coverage-aware sampling and curiosity-style targeted data collection

papers.title: Not All Actions Are Equal: Rethinking Conditioning for Dexterous World Model
papers.authors: Zizhao Yuan, Zhengtu Liang, Taowen Wang, Qiwei Liang, Yichi Wang, Yunheng Wang, Yuetong Fang, Lusong Li, Zecui Zeng, Renjing Xu
papers.published: arXiv API published 2026-06-25T17:36:35Z; official announcement batch: 2026-06-26 (/list cs.CV/new); categories: cs.CV
papers.summary: DexAC-WM 指出高自由度 dexterous action 不适合被压成单一全局条件向量，因为大尺度运动和细微接触信号量级差异很大。方法把 action conditioning 结构化为动作 tokenization、local refinement 和 global modulation，保留每个维度的语义和动力学影响。它还加入语义分支，为高自由度视频预测提供 object-scene prior。对手部操作世界模型来说，这篇论文的核心信息是: 结构化动作条件本身是建模能力，不只是附加输入。
methodHighlights: dimension-aware action tokenization for high-DoF dexterous control
local refinement plus global modulation aligns action signals with visual dynamics
semantic branch supplies object-scene priors for action-conditioned prediction

papers.title: RayPE: Ray-Space Positional Encoding for 3D-Aware Video Generation
papers.authors: Minghao Yin, Jiahao Lu, Wenbo Hu, Wang Zhao, Shan Ying, Kai Han
papers.published: arXiv API published 2026-06-25T17:51:02Z; official announcement batch: 2026-06-26 (/list cs.CV/new); categories: cs.CV
papers.summary: RayPE 针对视频 diffusion transformer 的位置编码缺少 3D 场景结构这一问题。作者用 Plucker ray 的 reciprocal product 描述相机射线之间的几何关系，并把每个 token 的 6D Plucker 坐标加到 self-attention 的 query/key 中。注意力分数被分解为内容项、几何项和交叉项，让模型在视频生成中显式感知 camera rays。模块参数量小于 0.1%，可零初始化接入预训练 DiT，却提升相机可控性、跨帧 3D 一致性和视频质量。
methodHighlights: injects per-token 6D Plucker ray coordinates into DiT attention
attention decomposes into content, geometry, and cross terms
handles heterogeneous camera-translation scales with magnitude gating and normalization

papers.title: PanoImager: Geometry-Guided Novel View Synthesis and Reconstruction from Sparse Panoramic Views
papers.authors: Zhisong Xu, Takeshi Oishi
papers.published: arXiv API published 2026-06-25T14:15:09Z; official announcement batch: 2026-06-26 (/list cs.CV/new); categories: cs.CV
papers.summary: PanoImager 解决稀疏全景图下 3D 重建的弱视差和旋转主导问题，尤其是 SfM/SLAM 难以初始化的场景。它绕过传统 SfM 初始化，结合 feed-forward pose/depth priors、geometry-conditioned diffusion view completion 和 depth-guided 3DGS optimization。方法将全景图拆成局部透视视图，并合成辅助观察来补足稀疏证据。对室内外全景建图来说，它适合作为 SLAM 初始化失败后的离线或后台几何补强模块。
methodHighlights: SfM-free sparse panorama reconstruction
geometry-conditioned diffusion completes auxiliary views
depth-guided 3DGS optimization improves cross-view consistency

papers.title: SatSplatDiff: Geometry-preserving generative refinement for high-fidelity satellite Gaussian Splatting
papers.authors: Jiyong Kim, Shuang Song, Ronjgun Qin
papers.published: arXiv API published 2026-06-25T16:12:36Z; official announcement batch: 2026-06-26 (/list cs.CV/new); categories: cs.CV
papers.summary: SatSplatDiff 面向卫星 3D Gaussian Splatting，处理顶部视角监督不足导致建筑立面空洞和渲染质量差的问题。直接用生成模型逐视图 refinement 会带来 hallucination 和 photo-consistency 破坏，进而损伤几何。论文在 photogrammetric DSM initialization 和 2DGS shadow casting 基础上加入 monocular depth supervision、多尺度几何 refinement 和 shadow-guided generative refinement。它的重点不是单纯让图像更好看，而是在传感器一致和几何误差可控的前提下做高分辨率增强。
methodHighlights: monocular depth supervision plus multi-scale geometric refinement
shadow-guided generative refinement preserves satellite scene geometry
reports lower geometric MAE and improved visual fidelity on IARPA2016/DFC2019

papers.title: Capacity-Controlled Multi-View Stylization of 3D Gaussian Splatting
papers.authors: Zhihao Wen, Yixin Yang, Bojian Wu, Yang Zhou, Dani Lischinski, Daniel Cohen-Or, Hui Huang
papers.published: arXiv API published 2026-06-25T08:36:50Z; official announcement batch: 2026-06-26 (/list cs.CV/new); categories: cs.CV
papers.summary: 这篇工作把 3DGS 风格化中的跨视角一致性问题表述为带容量约束的局部风格匹配。传统方法在每个渲染视图独立做 2D feature matching，容易出现风格分配不稳定、多对一特征复用和视角不一致。作者用 semi-balanced optimal transport 加 column-capacity constraints 控制 style feature allocation，并加入 cross-view matching guidance 与几何正则。它适合需要可编辑但又不想牺牲场景语义结构的 3DGS 资产生产流程。
methodHighlights: semi-balanced optimal transport for local style matching
column-capacity constraints control style allocation
cross-view guidance and geometry regularization stabilize 3DGS stylization

papers.title: Vis4GS: A Visual Analytic Tool for 3D Gaussian Splatting Reconstruction
papers.authors: Kai-Yuan Lin, Aryabima Mandala Putra, Jui-Chi Lee, Shih-Hsuan Hung
papers.published: arXiv API published 2026-06-25T12:59:02Z; official announcement batch: 2026-06-26 (/list cs.GR/new); categories: cs.GR
papers.summary: Vis4GS 不是新的 3DGS 优化算法，而是用于理解和诊断 3DGS 重建失败的可视分析工具。它把最终渲染伪影连接到 Gaussian primitive 属性、view coverage、训练进度和 Gaussian genealogy。系统提供 Gaussian 分析视图、属性时间线、densification tree 和日志控制面板，支持 blur/needle-like artifact scoring。对 3DGS 工程化很有意义，因为它把“看最终图像调参”变成可追溯的 primitive-level 诊断流程。
methodHighlights: links rendered artifacts to Gaussian properties and training history
view coverage and Gaussian genealogy analysis
interactive diagnosis for blur and needle-like artifacts

papers.title: Sculpting NeRF Geometry: Human-Preference Fine-Tuning of a 3D-Aware Face GAN

methodHighlights: preference reward over NeRF density field
fine-tunes 3D-aware GAN without mesh or multi-view rendering supervision
density-consistency constraint trades geometry improvement against bounded appearance drift

papers.title: KRVF: A Source-Aware Semantic Voxel World Representation for Edge Mobile Manipulation
papers.authors: Runfeng Ling
papers.published: arXiv API published 2026-06-24T19:07:42Z; official announcement batch: 2026-06-26 (/list cs.RO/new); categories: cs.RO
papers.summary: KRVF 关注移动操作机器人在边缘算力下需要怎样的本地世界模型。它把局部世界状态表示为 task-oriented voxels，编码 occupancy、color、semantic evidence、temporal freshness 和 evidence source。与重建中心的 mapping pipeline 不同，KRVF 区分 measured occupancy 与 semantic-prior hypotheses，避免深度失败时把语义猜测错误地固化进几何。系统还可渲染 map-prior depth 供感知修复，并暴露 semantic objects 和 grasp candidates 等任务查询接口。
methodHighlights: source-aware semantic voxel representation for edge mobile manipulation
separates measured occupancy from semantic-prior hypotheses
map-prior depth rendering and task-level query operators for robot memory

papers.title: Play2Perfect: What Matters in Dexterous Play Pretraining for Precise Assembly?
papers.authors: Tyler Ga Wei Lum, Kushal Kedia, C. Karen Liu, Jeannette Bohg

papers.summary: Play2Perfect 研究多指灵巧手在精密装配前是否应该先通过 task-agnostic play 学会通用 manipulation priors。预训练阶段让机器人在多对象、多目标上学习 grasping、in-hand reorientation 和 pose reaching，随后再 finetune 到高精度接触任务。论文系统比较 object diversity、training objective、trajectory diversity 和 goal precision 等因素。结果显示 play prior 比从零 RL 高 33 倍样本效率，并能 zero-shot sim-to-real 迁移到 0.5 mm 间隙的 tight insertion。
methodHighlights: task-agnostic dexterous play pretraining
finetuning focuses exploration on precise contact-rich assembly
systematic analysis of diversity, objective, trajectory, and goal precision

papers.title: VibeAct: Vibration to Actions for Contact-Rich Reactive Robot Dexterity
papers.authors: Yuemin Mao, Uksang Yoo, Jean Oh, Jonathan Francis, Jeffrey Ichnowski
papers.published: arXiv API published 2026-06-25T17:50:07Z; official announcement batch: 2026-06-26 (/list cs.RO/new); categories: cs.RO
papers.summary: VibeAct 用嵌入灵巧手的压电麦克风捕捉高带宽 vibro-acoustic 接触信号，解决视觉遮挡下接触和滑移难以感知的问题。真实数据通过 teleoperation 采集，再在 calibrated digital clone 中回放，自动标注每个手指的 contact 和 slip。策略并不需要在仿真里生成原始音频，而是在真实和仿真之间共享 contact/slip 物理表示。对接触丰富的 regrasping、in-hand reorientation 和 insertion，持续滑移通道成为反应式控制的重要观测。
methodHighlights: piezoelectric microphones provide high-bandwidth vibrotactile sensing
real recordings replayed in a calibrated digital clone for contact/slip labels
policies train on shared physical contact/slip representation instead of raw audio simulation

papers.title: Tactile-WAM: Touch-Aware World Action Model with Tactile Asymmetric Attention
papers.authors: Siyu Wu, Linjing You, Junjie Zhu, Yaozu Liu, Changhao Zhang, Jian Liu, Weiqiang Wang, Qi Li, Jituo Li, Hengshuang Zhao
papers.published: arXiv API published 2026-06-25T06:54:56Z; official announcement batch: 2026-06-26 (/list cs.RO/new); categories: cs.RO
papers.summary: Tactile-WAM 把 tactile prediction 接进 World Action Model，但先识别了一个关键失败模式: tactile pollution。若无约束地把稀疏、局部、事件驱动的触觉 token 注入视觉动力学模型，反而会污染视频和动作预测。作者提出 Tactile Asymmetric Attention Mechanism，用 VideoClean mask 阻止 video query 访问 tactile key/value，同时让 action query 保留触觉信息，并用 touch-aware bias 调节动作 attention。它说明触觉世界模型不是简单多模态拼接，而需要非对称的信息路由。
methodHighlights: identifies tactile pollution in touch-augmented WAMs
VideoClean mask protects visual prediction while action queries use tactile tokens
touch-aware attention bias improves contact-rich manipulation success

papers.title: RelAfford6D: Relational 6D Affordance Graphs for Constraint-Driven Robotic Manipulation
papers.authors: Guodong Zhang, Qichen He, Wenyuan Xie, Shaokai Wu, Yanbiao Ji, Qiuchang Li, Bayram Bayramli, Yue Ding, Hongtao Lu
papers.published: arXiv API published 2026-06-25T13:42:26Z; official announcement batch: 2026-06-26 (/list cs.RO/new); categories: cs.RO
papers.summary: RelAfford6D 用训练自由的 Relational 6D Affordance Graph 连接自然语言指令、物体部件关系和可执行 6D 约束。系统先推断 primary interacting part 与 physical anchor 之间的语义拓扑，再用 vision foundation models 提升到 metric SE(3) poses。后续执行被写成 kinematic constraint satisfaction，机器人沿 revolute 或 prismatic manifolds 生成连续轨迹。对 articulated objects 操作来说，这种显式几何约束比孤立 contact point 或 latent affordance 更可解释、也更容易闭环修正。
methodHighlights: relational 6D affordance graph links interactive parts and physical anchors
vision foundation models lift semantic topology to metric SE(3) poses
analytic kinematic constraints for revolute/prismatic articulated manipulation

papers.title: SSI-Policy: Learning Structured Scene Interfaces for Vision-Language Robotic Manipulation
papers.authors: Kaijun Wang, Zikai Ouyang, Xuping Wu, Jinyi Hong, Wei Pan, Haibo Lu, Jia Pan, Wei Zhang, Linfang Zheng
papers.published: arXiv API published 2026-06-25T09:38:05Z; official announcement batch: 2026-06-26 (/list cs.RO/new); categories: cs.RO

methodHighlights: RGB-only Structured Scene Interface with depth, object layout, and motion cues
trainable from action-free video and robot-agnostic
improves low-demo LIBERO and real-world manipulation

papers.title: Learning Motion Feasibility from Point Clouds in Cluttered Environments
papers.authors: Sajid Ansari, Arthi, Girish Varma, Antony Thomas
papers.published: arXiv API published 2026-06-25T07:32:25Z; official announcement batch: 2026-06-26 (/list cs.RO/new); categories: cs.RO, cs.AI
papers.summary: 这篇论文把 motion feasibility prediction 直接建立在 cluttered scene 的 RGB-D/point cloud 观测上，减少 sampling-based motion planner 的无效尝试。作者构建包含 88 个扫描物体、190 个 cluttered tabletop scenes 和 270 万 grasp feasibility labels 的大规模 benchmark。比较 MLP、volumetric CNN 和 point-cloud Transformer 后，最佳 GRASPFC-PTX 在 novel objects 上达到 0.996 AUROC。它适合与任务与运动规划结合，作为几何场景到可行抓取/运动判断的快速过滤器。
methodHighlights: large benchmark with 2.7M grasp feasibility labels
raw RGB-D/point-cloud input for 7-DOF manipulation in clutter
point-cloud transformer predicts feasibility far faster than repeated SBMP attempts

papers.title: PressMimic: Pressure-Guided Motion Capture and Control for Humanoid Robot Imitation

papers.published: arXiv API published 2026-06-25T08:24:35Z; official announcement batch: 2026-06-26 (/list cs.RO/new); categories: cs.RO, cs.CV
papers.summary: PressMimic 认为 humanoid motion imitation 不能只依赖视觉动捕和运动学 imitation，因为接触动力学缺失会造成脚滑、穿地和不稳定。它把压力作为从感知到控制的统一物理 grounding 信号。FRAPPE++ 融合 RGB 和压力来估计 3D pose 与 global motion，压力提供接触和支撑约束来消除视觉歧义。控制阶段的 pressure-supervised policy 则把压力派生信号注入 RL，使 humanoid 执行时接触模式更物理一致。
methodHighlights: RGB-plus-pressure motion capture for 3D pose and global motion
pressure-derived contact/support constraints reduce kinematic ambiguity
pressure-supervised humanoid control improves stable contact execution

papers.title: OmniContact: Chaining Meta-Skills via Contact Flow for Generalizable Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
papers.authors: Runyi Yu, Xiaoyi Lin, Ji Ma, Yinhuai Wang, Koukou Luo, Jiahao Ji, Huayi Wang, Wenjia Wang, Runhan Zhang, Ping Tan, Ting Wu, Ruoli Dai, Qifeng Chen, Lei Han

CF-Track skill library and CF-Gen contact-flow chaining
MoCap-based HOI corpus for humanoid loco-manipulation

papers.title: RobOralScan: Learning Active Intraoral Scanning for Robotic Dental Reconstruction
papers.authors: Jinhyung Lee, Haeun Yun, Siwon Kim, Gihyun Baek, Sungho Moon, Sehyun Hwang, Sunghoon Im

tooth-wise coverage learning balances global and per-tooth reconstruction quality
closed-loop scanner motion policy with zero-shot sim-to-real demonstration

59-hour synchronized dataset across environments and degraded sensing
late-fusion masked autoencoder with modality-specific tokenizers and cached tokens

papers.authors: Wen Ye, Peiyan Li, Tingyu Yuan, Yuan Xu, Xiangnan Wu, Chaoyang Zhao, Jing Liu, Nianfeng Liu, Yan Huang, Liang Wang
papers.published: arXiv API published 2026-06-25T16:50:21Z; official announcement batch: 2026-06-26 (/list cs.RO/new); categories: cs.RO, cs.AI
papers.summary: E-TTS 将 test-time scaling 引入 embodied manipulation，并把 reasoning scaling 与 action scaling 统一在闭环迭代中。框架保存历史上下文，用 vision-language verifiers 对 reasoning-action joint samples 成对评分。与 open-loop TTS 不同，它会生成反馈并迭代 refine 候选动作，强调长时程任务中的历史信息。它的实用意义在于不重新收集专家数据、不重训 base VLA，也能在多 benchmark、多 embodiment 上提升执行成功率。
methodHighlights: history-aware reasoning-action joint sampling and scoring
vision-language verifiers drive closed-loop test-time refinement
plug-and-play across multiple VLA models and embodiments

papers.title: WatchAct: A Benchmark for Behavior-Grounded Robot Manipulation
papers.authors: Baiqi Li, Ce Zhang, Yu Fang, Yue Yang, Shangzhe Li, Mingyu Ding, Gedas Bertasius
papers.published: arXiv API published 2026-06-24T23:13:56Z; official announcement batch: 2026-06-26 (/list cs.RO/new); categories: cs.RO, cs.AI, cs.CV
papers.summary: WatchAct 评估机器人能否从观察到的人类行为视频中理解发生了什么、意图是什么，以及场景如何被改变。每个样本把真实 human-action video、语言指令、对齐的 simulator scene 和可执行 LIBERO task 绑定在一起。3000 个长时程实例覆盖 event grounding、procedural reasoning、implicit intent inference 和 episodic reasoning。它对 HOI/机器人任务理解的价值在于，把人类行为观察转化为可复现实验中的计划推理与策略执行评测。
methodHighlights: pairs human-action videos with aligned simulator scenes and executable LIBERO tasks
disentangled evaluation of video-to-plan reasoning, policy execution, and full pipeline success
3,000 long-horizon behavior-grounded manipulation instances

reports.title: arXiv 三维视觉与 Physical AI 日报 - 2026-06-25
reports.summary: 最近一天命中 25 篇，补充 0 篇；VLA 动作先验、world modeling、3DGS/4D 表示和力觉操作最突出。
trends: 2026-06-25 最近公告批次里，3D 表示的重点不是再提出全新渲染原语，而是把 3DGS/4D proxy/对象 SLAM 变成可编辑、可控制、可部署的系统: TryOnCrafter、MVTrack4Gen、Support-Aware Appearance 和 DSP-SLAM++ 最有代表性。
机器人 VLA 正在从纯视觉-语言对齐转向显式动作先验、世界模型上下文和几何/空间 grounding: Learning Action Priors、ICWM、SVP-IL、WOLF-VLA、HALO 都在补 VLA 的物理执行短板。
Physical AI 线索很密集: ForceBand 用肌电补力觉示范，RigPI 用 VLM 初始化可微仿真参数识别，DeformGen 用动力学生成可变形物体增强，AISPO 把深度补全目标转向可抓取性。
导航和 SLAM 方向更强调语义地图与长期记忆: RoboAtlas、RAVEN、SAGE-Nav 和 fARfetch 都把 3D/空间结构放在 VLM/LLM 推理之前，避免只依赖语言模型临场猜测。

最值得优先深读的是 Learning Action Priors、In-Context World Modeling、RoboAtlas、ForceBand、TryOnCrafter、MVTrack4Gen、Support-Aware Appearance、DSP-SLAM++、RigPI 和 DynaMOMA；它们分别对应动作先验、世界模型适配、3D 语义 SLAM、力觉示范、4D 可控生成、多视角几何监督、3DGS 外观烘焙、对象级 SLAM、物理参数识别和动态抓取。

papers.title: Learning Action Priors for Cross-embodiment Robot Manipulation
papers.authors: Dong Jing, Tianqi Zhang, Jiaqi Liu, Jinman Zhao, Zelong Sun, Li Erran Li, Zhiwu Lu, Mingyu Ding
papers.published: arXiv API published 2026-06-24T17:59:56Z; official announcement batch: 2026-06-25 (/list cs.RO/new); categories: cs.RO, cs.AI, cs.CV
papers.summary: 这篇论文指出，现有 VLA 往往直接在视觉-语言 backbone 后接动作模块，动作时间结构需要从零开始学，尤其在跨 embodiment 任务中收敛慢、数据效率低。作者先用未条件化动作轨迹预训练一个轻量 flow-matching encoder-decoder 动作模块，再把 decoder 和 latent distillation 迁移进 VLA 训练。训练好的 encoder 还能把状态-动作历史压成一个时间上下文 token，用极小代价支持 history-aware policy。结果显示，在 13 个仿真和真实跨 embodiment 任务上，动作先验带来更快收敛、更高成功率和更强低数据泛化。
methodHighlights: two-stage training: action-prior pretraining before visual-language-action alignment
flow-matching action module learns temporal motion structure from raw action trajectories
latent distillation and decoder reuse transfer the prior into cross-embodiment VLA policies

papers.title: In-Context World Modeling for Robotic Control
papers.authors: Siyin Wang, Junhao Shi, Senyu Fei, Zhaoyang Fu, Li Ji, Jingjing Gong, Xipeng Qiu
papers.published: arXiv API published 2026-06-24T16:53:36Z; official announcement batch: 2026-06-25 (/list cs.RO/new); categories: cs.RO, cs.CV
papers.summary: ICWM 把机器人系统辨识改写成 in-context adaptation 问题，而不是每遇到新相机视角或机器人形态就重新微调。策略在执行任务前先观察一小段自生成、任务无关交互历史，从中推断当前系统的关键变量和动力学。这里的上下文不是告诉模型“做什么任务”，而是让模型理解“这个系统如何运作”。仿真和真实平台实验表明，这种 world modeling 上下文显著提升 VLA 对新视角和新配置的泛化。
methodHighlights: uses short self-generated interaction histories for in-context system identification
separates how-the-world-works context from task demonstrations
adapts robotic control to novel camera viewpoints and robot configurations without parameter updates

papers.title: RoboAtlas: Contextual Active SLAM
papers.authors: Alexander Schperberg, Shivam K. Panda, Abraham P. Vinod, M. K. Jawed, Stefano Di Cairano
papers.published: arXiv API published 2026-06-24T17:26:07Z; official announcement batch: 2026-06-25 (/list cs.RO/new); categories: cs.RO, cs.CV
papers.summary: RoboAtlas 是一个 contextual Active SLAM 框架，在几何探索和语义推理之间自适应切换。系统以 OpenRoboVox 构建可扩展 3D 语义地图，并用 contextual multi-armed bandit 融合 frontier exploration、全局语义地图推理和 egocentric VLM 推理。论文在超过 1800 平方米真实环境和约 3 万语义实例的 Unitree Go2 部署中达到 100% 任务成功率。它说明在具身导航里，基础模型性能之外，大规模 3D 语义地图本身就是关键能力。
methodHighlights: scalable 3D semantic mapping with OpenRoboVox
contextual bandit balances geometric exploration and semantic navigation
large real-world deployment plus GOAT-Bench evaluation

papers.title: ForceBand: Learning Forceful Manipulation with sEMG
papers.authors: Botao He, Zhi Wang, Linna Kuang, Ishaan Ghosh, Jitendra Malik, Cornelia Fermuller, Tingfan Wu, Jiayuan Mao, Ruoshi Liu, Haozhi Qi, Yiannis Aloimonos
papers.published: arXiv API published 2026-06-24T17:59:35Z; official announcement batch: 2026-06-25 (/list cs.RO/new); categories: cs.RO
papers.summary: ForceBand 关注普通人类示范缺少接触力信息的问题，因为视频和动捕通常只记录运动与外观。论文提出低成本腕戴 sEMG 系统，采集 10 小时 egocentric video、sEMG、IMU 和指尖力数据，并预训练 EMG2Force 从肌电与惯性信号预测每指受力。经过少量用户标定后，示范者只需戴 ForceBand 加视频即可生成带力标签的机器人学习数据。在 pick、squeeze、place 等需要对象特定力控制的任务中，这种 force-enriched demonstration 明显提升操作成功率。
methodHighlights: wrist-worn sEMG plus IMU estimates per-finger force for demonstrations
10-hour multimodal dataset with egocentric video and fingertip force measurements
force-augmented demonstrations improve manipulation requiring contact-force control

papers.title: TryOnCrafter: Unleashing Camera Trajectories for Realistic Video Virtual Try-on via a Renderable 4D Try-on Proxy
papers.authors: Hao Sun, Hao Yan, Mengting Chen, Quanjian Song, Yu Li, Juan Cao, Jinsong Lan, Xiaoyong Zhu, Bo Zheng, Sheng Tang
papers.published: arXiv API published 2026-06-24T17:59:06Z; source: API latest within 2026-06-25 run window, while /list cs.CV/new showed no updates at run time; categories: cs.CV
papers.summary: TryOnCrafter 定义了 camera-controllable video virtual try-on，希望虚拟试衣不再被源视频相机轨迹限制。核心是 Renderable 4D Try-on Proxy: 先把高质量 2D try-on prior 蒸馏到穿衣 3DGS avatar，再用 SMPL-X 序列驱动并与重建背景点云度量对齐。Proxy-Anchored Video DiT 以这个可渲染 4D 结构为几何锚，生成可按任意相机轨迹控制且保持非刚体人体动态一致的视频。对 4D human generation 和可控视角生成来说，它把 3DGS、人体模型和视频扩散模型连接得很紧。
methodHighlights: renderable 4D try-on proxy built from clothed 3DGS avatar and SMPL-X motion
metric alignment with reconstructed background point cloud
Proxy-Anchored Video DiT enforces camera-trajectory control and deformation plausibility

papers.title: MVTrack4Gen: Multi-View Point Tracking as Geometric Supervision for 4D Video Generation
papers.authors: JoungBin Lee, Jaewoo Jung, Jongmin Lee, Tongmin Kim, Hyunsung Kim, Takuya Narihira, Kazumi Fukuda, Jahyeok Koo, Jisang Han, Yuki Mitsufuji, Seungryong Kim
papers.published: arXiv API published 2026-06-24T17:56:33Z; source: API latest within 2026-06-25 run window, while /list cs.CV/new showed no updates at run time; categories: cs.CV
papers.summary: MVTrack4Gen 面向从单目参考视频按目标相机轨迹合成 novel-view video 的几何一致性问题。作者发现特定 attention 层已经编码跨视角和跨时间的 correspondence cue，错位会导致运动不一致。方法把这些特征接入辅助 multi-view tracking head，用点跟踪目标联合训练 camera-conditioning video diffusion model。它不依赖不稳定的显式动态重建模块，而是把 tracking 监督直接注入生成模型内部。
methodHighlights: multi-view point tracking objective supervises novel-view video diffusion
routes correspondence-rich attention features into an auxiliary tracking head
improves geometric and motion consistency for 4D video generation

papers.title: From Sparse and Imperfect 2D Anchors to Consistent 3D Gaussian Street Scenes: Support-Aware Appearance
papers.authors: Long Cao, Zhongquan Wang, Jie Li, Yuhan Chen, Kefei Qian, Xiangfei Huang, Guofa Li
papers.published: arXiv API published 2026-06-24T16:26:53Z; official announcement batch: 2026-06-25 (/list cs.GR/new cross-list); categories: cs.CV, cs.GR
papers.summary: 这篇工作处理 3D Gaussian street scenes 的外观编辑/条件迁移问题: 2D 图像先验能生成目标条件，但独立编辑多视角会产生不一致噪声。论文用 teacher-relative appearance residual distillation 构建频率分解、置信估计和 primitive-level lifting 的结构化空间。support-aware Gaussian-space aggregation 只接纳被多视角支持的细节，并抑制 unsupported noise，最后把残差烘焙进固定几何的 SH 系数。对自动驾驶 3DGS 场景资产来说，这是把 2D 生成先验落到可部署 3D 表示的一步。
methodHighlights: teacher-relative residual distillation for 3DGS appearance baking
confidence-gated coarse-to-fine optimization suppresses unsupported 2D noise
fixed-geometry SH coefficients keep standard rasterizer deployment

papers.title: DSP-SLAM++: A Unified Framework for Multi-Class, High-Fidelity Object SLAM in the Wild
papers.authors: Ahmad Kourani, Ghina Daoud, Daniel Asmar, Imad Elhajj
papers.published: arXiv API published 2026-06-24T15:27:23Z; official announcement batch: 2026-06-25 (/list cs.RO/new); categories: cs.RO, cs.CV
papers.summary: DSP-SLAM++ 扩展 DSP-SLAM，目标是在真实环境中同时满足实时性、多类别支持和高保真语义对象模型。系统引入异步 mapping pipeline，缓解对象建图线程瓶颈，并针对 monocular fisheye-LiDAR 传感器组合做融合适配。论文报告在 25 Hz 多类别数据集上将最大对象处理延迟降低最高 70%，同时生成更完整细粒度形状。它对机器人操作和自动驾驶都重要，因为 object-level SLAM 只有实时且多类别，才能成为可用的交互世界模型。
methodHighlights: asynchronous object mapping pipeline for real-time multi-class object SLAM
sensor fusion adaptations for monocular fisheye-LiDAR setups
high-fidelity semantically coherent object reconstruction in the wild

papers.title: DynaMOMA: Instantaneous Prediction of Grasp Poses for Mobile Manipulation of Dynamic Objects
papers.authors: Zhinan Yu, Junyan Xu, Jiazhao Zhang, Zheng Qin, Yijie Tang, Yuhang Huang, Yihan Cao, Zhiyuan Yu, Yongjun Wang, Renjiao Yi, Chenyang Zhu, Kai Xu
papers.published: arXiv API published 2026-06-24T01:58:15Z; official announcement batch: 2026-06-25 (/list cs.RO/new); categories: cs.RO
papers.summary: DynaMOMA 研究移动机器人抓取动态物体时，底盘、机械臂和目标连续变化之间的协调。方法用 anchor-based diffusion model 根据历史观测预测短时、时间一致的 grasp trajectories，再把轨迹编码成 compact feature 输入 whole-body RL policy。anticipation-guided reward 会把策略目标从当前抓取观测自适应前移到预测抓取轨迹，给机器人留出提前量。它对动态抓取的启发是，将抓取预测作为 whole-body control 的显式前瞻变量，而不是只做即时反应。
methodHighlights: anchor-based diffusion predicts short-horizon grasp trajectories
whole-body RL policy consumes trajectory features for mobile manipulation
anticipation-guided reward shifts control target toward predicted future grasp poses

papers.title: RigPI: Dynamic Parameter Identification of Rigid Body via VLM-Seeded Differentiable Simulation
papers.authors: Xincheng He, Rongrong Zhang, Wei Jiang, Wenqiang Xu
papers.published: arXiv API published 2026-06-23T22:15:42Z; official announcement batch: 2026-06-25 (/list cs.RO/new); categories: cs.RO
papers.summary: RigPI 面向机器人操作中的动态参数识别，包括自由刚体和带 revolute/prismatic joints 的多连杆物体。VLM 提供语义先验、初始化和受约束搜索空间，力矩、运动观测与可微物理仿真共同优化惯量、摩擦等参数。两阶段优化减少噪声敏感性，避免物理上不合理的解。对 articulated objects 和数字孪生而言，它把语言/视觉先验与 differentiable simulation 结合成可落地的系统辨识流程。
methodHighlights: VLM-seeded initialization and constrained search for physical parameters
differentiable simulation refines inertial and frictional properties
handles unconstrained and multi-link rigid bodies during robot-object interaction

papers.title: GRAFT: Graph-Based Affordance Transfer via Part Correspondence
papers.authors: Mengying Lin, Utkarsh Mishra, Ajay Mandlekar, Danfei Xu
papers.published: arXiv API published 2026-06-23T23:58:57Z; official announcement batch: 2026-06-25 (/list cs.RO/new); categories: cs.RO
papers.summary: GRAFT 关注机器人如何把一个物体上的操作 affordance 迁移到未见过的新物体。它不用单纯语义检索，而是把物体表示为 part-based graphs，用部件级描述子做实例检索和部件对应，再用 vertex-level descriptors 做细粒度接触点匹配。对于新物体，系统先找功能和几何都相似的 demonstration instance，再通过点级对应传播接触点。它适合少样本操作泛化，因为真正的迁移单位是功能部件和接触几何。
methodHighlights: part-based graph representation for object retrieval and correspondence
combines functional similarity with geometric part alignment
propagates contact points for zero-shot manipulation transfer from one demonstration

papers.title: DeformGen: Dynamics-Based Topology Augmentation for Deformable Manipulation Policy Learning
papers.authors: Zili Lin, Wenyao Zhang, Yuyang Zhang, Zekun Qi, Junyan Lin, Hanxin Zhu, Jiaolong Yang, Zhibo Chen, Yao Mu, Xiaokang Yang, Xin Jin, Wenjun Zeng
papers.published: arXiv API published 2026-06-24T15:15:38Z; official announcement batch: 2026-06-25 (/list cs.RO/new); categories: cs.RO
papers.summary: DeformGen 针对 deformable manipulation 的数据增强问题，指出刚体式位姿扰动无法生成物理可达且拓扑合理的变形状态。方法对可变形物体施加局部物理扰动，再 forward-simulate dynamics 得到 topology-coherent states。轨迹迁移则通过 deformation-field warping，把粒子位移提升为连续空间函数，从而同步调整末端执行器轨迹。它把 state augmentation 和 behavior augmentation 绑定在同一物理过程里，对布料、绳索、软物体操作很有价值。
methodHighlights: localized physical disturbances plus forward simulation create valid deformable states
deformation-field warping transfers manipulation trajectories across changed topology
augments state distribution and associated behavior jointly for policy learning

papers.title: Decoupling Semantics and Geometric Grounding: Spatial Visual Prompts for Language-Conditioned Imitation Learning
papers.authors: Yanzhe Tang, Xinyu Shao, Yuxuan Hu, Siyu Chen, Bowen Yang, Yajun Gao, Tongtong Cao, Xiu Li, Long Zeng
papers.published: arXiv API published 2026-06-24T03:45:06Z; official announcement batch: 2026-06-25 (/list cs.RO/new); categories: cs.RO
papers.summary: SVP-IL 把 language-conditioned imitation learning 中的语义理解和空间控制解耦，避免端到端 VLA 把目标消歧和动作生成压在同一隐空间里。方法用 vision-language foundation model 从指令解析零样本几何 mask，并转成 Spatial Visual Prompts 注入连续动作生成器。这样给低数据模仿学习提供明确、未污染的空间梯度，尤其适合有歧义的目标选择任务。论文在 50 到 100 条示范的低数据设置和真实机器人实验中都显示出更稳定的泛化。
methodHighlights: parses instructions into zero-shot geometric masks using vision-language foundation models
injects Spatial Visual Prompts into the action generator through lightweight feature fusion
decouples semantic target reasoning from geometric control for low-data imitation learning

papers.title: AISPO: Enhancing Depth Reliability for Robotic Manipulation of Non-Lambertian Objects via Affine-Invariant Shape Prior
papers.authors: Zhiming Chen, Linfang Zheng, Kun Zhang, Hyung Jin Chang, Wei Zhang, Hongyu Yu, Hua Chen
papers.published: arXiv API published 2026-06-24T07:37:11Z; official announcement batch: 2026-06-25 (/list cs.RO/new); categories: cs.RO, cs.CV
papers.summary: AISPO 解决透明和高反光物体导致 RGB-D 深度缺失或错误的问题，这些错误会直接传播到抓取规划。方法结合多尺度 RGB-D feature fusion 和 affine-invariant shape prior，不只优化平均深度误差，而是强调物理可用性和结构完整性。真实抓取实验显示，更可靠的深度显著提升非 Lambertian 物体操作成功率。对机器人三维感知而言，深度补全的评价目标应从像素精度转向规划可执行性。
methodHighlights: affine-invariant shape prior enforces geometric consistency in depth completion
multi-scale RGB-D fusion targets transparent and specular objects
real-world grasping validates physically usable depth rather than only average accuracy

papers.title: TacVerse: A Multi-Sensor Dataset and Benchmark for Cross-Sensor Vision-Based Tactile Perception
papers.authors: Lan Wei, Gurmeher Khurana, Sirine Bhouri, Wenhao Hong, Zeyuan Xin, Qingzheng Cong, Wen Fan, Yanzheng Xiang, Dandan Zhang
papers.published: arXiv API published 2026-06-24T14:22:48Z; official announcement batch: 2026-06-25 (/list cs.RO/new); categories: cs.RO
papers.summary: TacVerse 是面向 vision-based tactile sensors 的跨传感器数据集和 benchmark，包含来自 7 种 VBTS 的 106,800 张触觉图像。任务覆盖形状分类、grating 分类和力回归，并评估 within-sensor、zero-shot cross-sensor transfer 与 few-shot adaptation。结果表明，不同触觉传感器之间的 domain shift 很强，尤其对细粒度纹理和力回归更敏感。MAE 预训练在跨任务和跨传感器上表现最稳定，为触觉基础表示提供了可复现实验场。
methodHighlights: 106,800 tactile images from seven vision-based tactile sensors
benchmarks within-sensor, zero-shot cross-sensor, and few-shot adaptation settings
studies self-supervised pretraining for tactile representation transfer

papers.title: BFMTrack: Latent Sequence Optimization for Physics-Based Motion Tracking with Behavioral Foundation Models
papers.authors: Thomas Rupf, Agon Serifi, David Müller, Sammy Christen, Ruben Grandia, Espen Knoop, Moritz Bächer
papers.published: arXiv API published 2026-06-23T18:12:22Z; official announcement batch: 2026-06-25 (/list cs.RO/new); categories: cs.RO
papers.summary: BFMTrack 让 behavioral foundation models 支持 time-varying motion tracking，而不仅是到达目标或状态奖励优化。论文提出 Latent Sequence Optimization，在仿真 rollout 中用 policy gradient 优化一整段 latent sequence，并用 temporally correlated noise 保持 latent 轨迹平滑连贯。方法不需要重新做 reward engineering，就能处理 dense tracking、sparse keyframing，并部署到真实 humanoid robot。它对 Physical AI 的启发是，大规模行为先验需要能被序列约束精确牵引，才能服务动作重建和机器人执行。
methodHighlights: optimizes sequences of behavioral-model latents for motion tracking
simulation rollouts plus policy-gradient updates avoid task-specific reward tuning
temporally correlated noise encourages coherent latent trajectories

papers.title: WOLF-VLA: Whole-Body Humanoid Optimal Locomotion Framework for Vision-Language-Action Learning
papers.authors: Melya Boukheddimi, Omar Adjali, Daniel Sontag, Frank Kirchner

papers.summary: WOLF-VLA 把 VLA 从常见的机械臂操作扩展到 contact-rich humanoid whole-body locomotion。作者用 whole-body optimal-control motion synthesis 构建动态可行轨迹，并生成包含环境变化、物体颜色/位置、视觉干扰和语言指令的大规模多模态数据集。训练得到的 VLA 直接从自然语言、视觉和关节轨迹生成 humanoid locomotion policy。论文承诺开放数据集、模型和仿真 benchmark，对 instruction-driven humanoid control 是有用基础设施。
methodHighlights: optimal-control synthesis provides dynamically feasible humanoid demonstrations
multi-modal dataset spans six locomotion-related task families
trains VLA policies for language-conditioned whole-body humanoid locomotion

papers.title: G2DP: Diffusion Planning with Spatio-Temporal Grid Guidance

reports.title: arXiv 三维视觉与 Physical AI 日报 - 2026-06-24
reports.summary: 最近一天命中 29 篇，补充 0 篇；3DGS/显式资产、几何 VLA、world-model value 和 physics-aware policy 最突出。
trends: 最新 2026-06-24 公告批次的三维视觉主线明显转向“可用资产和可交互表示”: ArtiTwinSplat、Pocket-SLAM、FLAT、FLUX3D、OrbitForge、3DCarGen 和 MM-TRELLIS 都在把 3DGS、triangle splats、mesh 或点云条件推向可渲染、可仿真、可部署的 3D 资产。
机器人方向的重点是让 VLA 和 diffusion policy 更接近真实物理约束: InSight 做自引导技能获取，G^3VLA 注入几何归纳偏置，NoContactNoWorries 和 TACTFUL 强调接触/触觉，Physics-Guided Diffusion Control 与 Cloth Sim-in-the-Loop 则把可行性校验和模拟器放到推理时。
世界模型继续从“预测视频”扩展为“规划和价值接口”: World Value Models 用 world model 估计机器人轨迹价值，NavWM 用视觉 foresight 做闭环导航，DynaWM 用 world model 约束运动表示。
3D 生成评估正在变严: GeoT2V-Bench 明确用重建诊断 text-to-video 的 3D 一致性，OrbitForge 也强调 coverage-aware evaluation，说明视觉逼真度已经不足以支撑 3D asset generation。

最值得优先深读的是 ArtiTwinSplat、InSight、FLAT、FLUX3D、OrbitForge、World Value Models、G^3VLA、NoContactNoWorries、NavWM 和 Pocket-SLAM；它们分别对应 articulated 3DGS digital twin、自主技能增长、显式表面生成、3DGS 原生生成、视频先验到 3D 场景、world-model value learning、几何 VLA、接触估计、导航 world model 和可扩展 3DGS-SLAM。

trends: 今天最新提交明显围绕“可交互的 3D/4D 表示”展开: Lift4D、Ocean4D、MeGAS 和 IOI 都把几何、时间、物理或介质因素纳入重建/渲染/world model，而不是只追求静态外观质量。

3D 生成更强调显式结构控制和原生表示，Arbor 用 constraint meshes 表达生成空间约束，MeshFlow 直接在 triangle mesh 对称性上做等变 flow matching。
HOI/手物交互和 humanoid 操作继续升温，IMAGIN-4D、LaST-HD、CoorDex、DexTeleop-0 都把人类交互、接触、身体-手协同或跨 embodiment 迁移作为关键数据来源。
最值得优先深读的是 Lift4D、IMAGIN-4D、IOI、MeGAS、Arbor、SkyJEPA、HoloAgent-0、LIBERO-Safety 和 Flow6D；它们分别对应 4D 重建、HOI 生成、交互 world model、physics-aware 3DGS、可控 3D 生成、长程机器人 world model、空间记忆 agent、安全 VLA 和机器人 6D pose。

papers.title: Modality Forcing for Scalable Spatial Generation

从 370M 到 3.3B 参数验证 T2I scale 对 depth 的收益。

papers.title: SpatialClaw: Rethinking Action Interface for Agentic Spatial Reasoning

papers.title: WEAVER, Better, Faster, Longer: An Effective World Model for Robotic Manipulation
papers.authors: Arnav Kumar Jain, Yilin Wu, Jesse Farebrother, Gokul Swamy, Andrea Bajcsy

显式面向 long-horizon dynamic manipulation 设计。
硬件验证覆盖策略评估、策略改进和 test-time planning。

papers.title: RepWAM: World Action Modeling with Representation Visual-Action Tokenizers
papers.authors: Junke Wang, Qihang Zhang, Shuai Yang, Yiming Luo, Yujun Shen, Zuxuan Wu, Yu-Gang Jiang, Yinghao Xu

语言条件下联合建模 future visual states 与 latent actions。
预训练后适配真实机器人轨迹进行闭环控制。

papers.title: MaskWAM: Unifying Mask Prompting and Prediction for World-Action Models

Mixture of Transformers 统一 RGB、mask 和 action modeling。
目标物体 mask 降低语言歧义并抑制背景噪声。

papers.title: NavWAM: A Navigation World Action Model for Goal-Conditioned Visual Navigation

papers.title: Mana: Dexterous Manipulation of Articulated Tools

papers.title: Making Foresight Actionable: Repurposing Representation Alignment in World Action Models

提升物体定位、affordance understanding 和 OOD 泛化。

联合优化手和物体 mesh，并加入 anti-penetration refinement。

用 inverse rendering 先验正则 Gaussian field 的材质属性。
服务真实捕获 3D 环境中的可控、可编辑渲染。

papers.title: Wild3R: Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting from Unconstrained Sparse Photo Collection

学习跨视图外观一致性并削弱临时物体污染。

papers.title: DarkVGGT: Seeing Through Darkness Using Thermal Geometry without Daylight Tax
papers.authors: Minseong Kweon, Wenyuan Zhao, Nuo Chen, Lulin Liu, Huiwen Han, Zihao Zhu, Srinivas Shakkottai, Chao Tian, Zhiwen Fan

用 geometry-shared thermal routing 区分通用几何和热成像特有模式。

papers.title: Bridging the Morphology Gap: Adapting VLA Models to Dexterous Manipulation via Intent-Conditioned Fine-Tuning

用 intent-conditioned diffusion head 缓解 action manifold collapse。

papers.title: TacCoRL: Integrating Tactile Feedback into VLA via Simulation

papers.title: PLUME: Probabilistic Latent Unified World Modeling and Parameter Estimation for Multi-Finger Manipulation

papers.title: 3D Skew-Normal Splatting
papers.authors: Xiangru Wu, Ke Fan, Yanwei Fu
papers.published: 公告批次: 2026-05-14 (Thursday, 14 May 2026); 分类: cs.CV
papers.summary: 这篇工作从 3DGS 的 primitive 形状入手，认为对称 Gaussian 在有限 primitive 预算下会损失边界和单侧结构的表达能力。作者把基础核改成 Azzalini Skew-Normal 之后，用可学习的 skewness 在对称 Gaussian 和更偏置的分布之间连续插值。这样既保留了解析可积性，也能更好地拟合尖边、薄结构和非对称表面。它属于那种看起来是“小改核函数”，但实质上在重新定义 3DGS 表达能力的工作。
methodHighlights: 用 Skew-Normal primitive 替代对称 Gaussian primitive。
通过 bounded skewness 实现连续形状控制。
采用解耦参数化和 block-wise optimization 提升训练稳定性。

papers.title: GaussianZoom: Progressive Zoom-in Generative 3D Gaussian Splatting with Geometric and Semantic Guidance
papers.authors: Jiale Shi, Jiarui Hu, Zesong Yang, Kaixuan Luan, Hujun Bao, Zhaopeng Cui
papers.published: 公告批次: 2026-05-18 (Monday, 18 May 2026); 分类: cs.CV
papers.summary: GaussianZoom 把“极限放大”当成 3D 重建问题来做，而不是单纯的超分或后处理。作者用多视图一致的 super-resolution 模块配合 depth-based feature warping 和 VLM-driven detail synthesis，让局部细节在多视图间仍保持一致。再加上可扩展的 continuous LoD 层级，模型能够在更大放大倍率下保持平滑、无锯齿的跨尺度渲染。它对 3D 生成和场景重建都很有启发，因为它把几何和语义一起纳入了 zoom-in 过程。
methodHighlights: 结合几何一致性和语义引导做 progressive zoom-in 重建。
用连续 LoD hierarchy 控制 Gaussian 可见性和跨尺度过渡。
强调极端放大时的多视图一致性，而不是只追单帧观感。

papers.title: GraspFoM: Towards Reconstruction-Driven Robotic Grasping with 3D Foundation Priors
papers.authors: Dongli Wu, Xiaobao Wei, Hao Wang, Qiaochu Dong, Ying Li, Qingpo Wuwu, Ming Lu, Wufan Zhao
papers.published: 公告批次: 2026-06-07 (Sunday, 7 June 2026); 分类: cs.RO, cs.CV

methodHighlights: 共享 3D object latent 同时服务 reconstruction 与 grasping。
用 pose-reasoning diffuser 生成连续、多模态 grasp poses。
输出 mesh 和 3DGS 两种三维资产形态。

papers.title: Recovering Physically Plausible Human-Object Interactions from Monocular Videos
papers.authors: Dingbang Huang, Etienne Vouga, Qixing Huang, Georgios Pavlakos
papers.published: 公告批次: 2026-06-03 (Wednesday, 3 June 2026); 分类: cs.CV, cs.RO
papers.summary: RePHO 处理的是 HOI 重建里最典型的矛盾: 运动轨迹看起来对，不代表物理上真的对。作者先做 kinematic estimate，再把结果交给物理模拟器驱动的 RL policy 继续优化，目标是让重建出的交互更少穿插、更少悬浮。为了避免噪声轨迹把 RL 带偏，论文还设计了自更新式采样机制，挑出最有信息量、也最可靠的帧来训练。它的价值在于把 HOI 从“像”推进到“可物理成立”。

采用 adaptive sampling + dual self-updating 机制稳定训练。
明确优化 physically plausible HOI，而不只是视觉相似度。

papers.title: Artiverse: A Diverse and Physically Grounded Dataset for Articulated Objects

覆盖 88 类、5.4K 物体，适合功能理解与仿真。
支持 part mobility analysis、articulated generation 和 physics-based interaction。

兼顾 future state prediction 和 closed-loop control。

父子 refinement 让细节层可以结构性纠错。

避免 mesh proxy、pose-dependent correction 和类别模板。

作为 plug-and-play 框架支持 pre-training、post-training 和 LAM refinement。

papers.summary: 这篇系统研究 everyday Internet videos 如何帮助机器人 manipulation policy cotraining，而不是依赖专门采集、动作像机器人的人类演示数据。作者构建了 532 段、28 小时带高质量三角化手部标签的自然人类视频数据。结果显示手部姿态质量确实重要，但仅有准确 hands 还不够，视觉和策略网络还需要按 embodiment specialization 处理人-机器人动作差异。低机器人数据场景下，cotraining recipe 在 6 个操作任务上带来 29.7 个百分点成功率提升。

papers.title: AEGIS: A Backup Reflex for Physical AI
papers.authors: Josef Chen

papers.summary: AEGIS 把长程机器人操作失败看作可提前预警的问题：很多失败不是突然发生，而是弱策略一步步把状态推入不可恢复区域。它在弱策略冻结 activations 上训练轻量 probe，提前检测高风险 step，并只在需要时切换到更强策略。LIBERO-Spatial 上它追回弱策略丢失轨迹的 10.1%，明显优于盲目升级和随机触发，同时只在 38% steps 启用强策略。它提供了一个 Physical AI 系统层思路：不要总是全程用大模型，而是在正确时机升级控制。
methodHighlights: Activation-probe Early-warning + Gated Inference Switching。
弱策略路径前 30% trajectory 即可进行早期风险判断。
选择性强策略接管，把 compute 用在临界步骤。

papers.title: GEM-4D: Geometry-Enhanced Video World Models for Robot Manipulation
papers.authors: Kaichen Zhou, Yuzhen Chen, Fangneng Zhan, Hang Hua, Grace Chen, Xinhai Chang, Ao Qu, Yilun Du, Zhuang Liu, Paul Pu Liang, Mengyu Wang
papers.published: arXiv API published: 2026-05-20 21:36:44 UTC; updated: 2026-06-05 16:29:58 UTC; 公告批次: 2026-06-08 (arXiv new listings: Monday, 8 June 2026); 分类: cs.CV, cs.RO
papers.summary: GEM-4D 是今日 replacement 中最值得补充的一篇：它指出视频世界模型虽然能生成看似合理的未来，但常无法跨时间稳定追踪同一物理点。方法从 geometry foundation model 蒸馏 dense 4D correspondence supervision 到视频生成 backbone，使模型同时保持外观生成和几何一致性。进一步的 inverse dynamics module 将 correspondence-consistent rollouts 转成可执行机器人轨迹，真实操作成功率从 61% 提升到 81%。它对 Physical AI 的核心启发是：世界模型要能指导动作，必须在视频生成内部绑定几何对应关系。

单流架构，推理时不增加额外成本。
